text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond's first G1 race is finally happening tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's in my bag. I even remembered to pack a spare pair of shoes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. And I've made sure they're properly attached. …Trainer, please try to relax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wanted to help her relax, but she ends up comforting me instead.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm getting a call. Please excuse me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hello? Father? Yes, I'm doing well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
choice_data_list: Was that your parents calling to cheer you on?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's right. …Hehehe! Father was checking to see if I forgot anything, just like you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Everyone around me is always more nervous than I am before a race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I told him I'm definitely going to win, but he still just told me to be careful not to get injured.
choice_data_list: I think that's what's most important to him.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You might be right. My parents have never once told me to win. They've always been so gentle with me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And that's precisely why I want to win tomorrow's race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I aspire to become an illustrious runner and to bring honor to my parents by being the first to realize our family's dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Despite being so busy, Mother and Father have both always dedicated themselves to advancing the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'd like to reward them for all their hard work! ♪
choice_data_list: You'll have to give them something fantastic, then!
You'll have to give them something fantastic, then!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Indeed! The Satono family's first G1 victory!
